title: Asthma Attack
summary: Sit them upright, help them use their reliever (usually blue) inhaler with a spacer if they have one, and call if it does not help quickly.

callEmergency.headline: Call {EMERGENCY} if the attack is severe or not improving
when: Too breathless to speak, eat or sleep
Lips or face blue or grey
Reliever inhaler not helping, or no inhaler available

steps.title: Sit them upright
steps.text: Help them sit up, leaning slightly forward. Keep calm and reassure them. Loosen tight clothing.

steps.title: Reliever inhaler
steps.text: Help them use their reliever inhaler, with a spacer if available, following their asthma action plan or the dose instructions for their inhaler.

steps.title: If not improving
steps.text: Call {EMERGENCY}. Keep giving the reliever as their action plan or the dispatcher advises while you wait.

steps.title: If they become unresponsive
steps.text: Check breathing. If not breathing normally, start CPR.

warningSigns: Silent chest / very little air movement
doNot: Do not assume a mild attack will settle without treatment

sources.body: American Heart Association and American Red Cross
